avoidColors.name: Clear Orange
avoidColors.explanation: Too warm and loud, making shadows around the face look stronger.

avoidColors.name: Bright Yellow
avoidColors.explanation: Adds yellow light the skin does not naturally repeat.

avoidColors.name: Pure Black
avoidColors.explanation: Too stark for the soft cool balance around the eyes and skin.

avoidColors.name: Optic White
avoidColors.explanation: Looks sharper than the face and can make the skin read flatter.

avoidColors.name: Hot Pink
avoidColors.explanation: Too saturated, so it competes with the face before supporting it.

avoidColors.name: Camel
avoidColors.explanation: Pulls beige-yellow warmth into the complexion.

avoidColors.name: Rust Brown
avoidColors.explanation: Adds earthy warmth that disconnects from the cool eyes.

avoidColors.name: Neon Green
avoidColors.explanation: Too acidic and bright for the natural softness.

avoidColors.name: Electric Cobalt
avoidColors.explanation: Too vivid and hard-edged, overpowering the features.

avoidColors.name: Coral
avoidColors.explanation: The warmth can make redness and under-eye shadows more visible.

best.reason: Silver resonates with your cool coloring, drawing out the serene hues in your overall palette.
White Gold offers a refined complement to your True Summer depth, less stark than silver yet seamlessly integrated.

avoid.reason: Yellow Gold introduces a warm note discordant with your cool tones, clashing visibly at the neckline.

metals.explanation: Cool metals align with your True Summer palette, enhancing harmony and refinement.

hairOptions.name: Cool Brunette
hairOptions.style: long soft layers with face-framing movement
hairOptions.description: Long soft layers keep the face open and follow the natural movement of the hair. The shape gives lift around the cheekbones without adding bulk at the jaw.

hairOptions.name: Mushroom Brown
hairOptions.description: A shoulder-length shape gives the waves structure while keeping the outline gentle. The length sits away from the chin, so the face stays balanced rather than boxed in.

hairOptions.name: Soft Ash Brown
hairOptions.style: long curtain layers with a soft bend
hairOptions.description: Curtain layers draw attention toward the eyes and cheekbones. The bend adds polish without making the style feel stiff or overly dramatic.
